subject.title: fix(sessions): bound AGENTS.md and prompt-input file reads with size cap

question: Should session prompt-input files above 10 MiB be rejected with a warning on upgrade, while project-context files remain uncapped?
rationale: This is an intentional user-visible compatibility boundary, not a correctness defect that automated repair can resolve without choosing the supported prompt-size policy.

options.title: Approve the 10 MiB boundary
options.body: Accept warning-and-skip behavior for oversized prompt inputs and merge the current focused implementation.

options.title: Preserve all existing prompt inputs
options.body: Remove the hard cap or replace it with an explicitly approved alternative before merge, accepting the remaining unbounded-read exposure.

options.title: Choose another bounded contract
options.body: Set an owner-approved cap or truncation policy and update the tests and proof to match it.

recommendation.title: Approve the 10 MiB boundary
recommendation.body: Accept warning-and-skip behavior for oversized prompt inputs and merge the current focused implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The implementation contributor can clarify the demonstrated behavior, although a sessions/product owner should make the policy decision.
